title: 第23章 并案调查

第23章 并案调查-《我发现了世界BUG》

上一章

存书签

下一章

这个世界远比自己想象的还要复杂。

林舒第一次产生这种想法是在刚刚验证“蓍龟占卜”的仪轨有效的那一刻。

第二次，是在乱葬岗里仰望星空的时候。

而第三次，就是现在。

不过这一次的感受跟前两次截然不同。

前两次自己只是对“世界规则”发出感叹，而这一次，自己是对“世界规则下的社会规则”发出了疑问。

如果官方真的了解仪轨、掌握仪轨，那就证明，自己生活在一套被精心编织出来的隔离体系之中。

他们控制着有关仪轨的知识、阻止这种知识在世界流动。

这难道不是一种......独裁？

但仔细想想也不对。

如果他们真的早就已经了解了有关仪轨的一切，那么他们应该也同样早就形成了一套针对“仪轨事件”的成熟的、完善的处理方法。

他们不应该做得那么明显----至少不应该把徐长顺的事情定性成谋杀，引起所有知情者的怀疑。

所以总的来说......

官方此时，更像是处于一种刚刚接触新事物的迷茫状态，就跟自己一样？

唯一的差别就是，他们的信息源更广，很可能已经掌握了许多类似的案件信息。

或许，他们甚至还把这些莫名其妙的“同类案件”，当成了某种新型犯罪手段并案侦查了.....

再结合厉雨给出的有关“大乱”的猜测......

没错，这就是最合理的解释。

想到这里，林舒稍稍松了口气。

----起码在这个背景下，官方还没有成为反派嘛。

不然的话，自己还是直接躺平比较安全了......

“你想啥呢？”

坐在沙发上的谢雨迟好奇地看向林舒，林舒回过神来，咳嗽一声道：

“没有，我就在想徐长顺的事情。”

“你说有没有可能，警方后续会要求开棺验尸？”

“确实有可能。”

谢雨迟点点头。

“但那跟你也没关系了----还是那句话，不该咱们管的事情，你还是少掺和吧。”

“好啦，我要走了。”

“明天晚上有时间吗？一起吃个饭？”

“约会啊？”

林舒贫嘴了一句，谢雨迟翻了个白眼。

“约你个头，你说出这种话，感觉有点骨科的味道。”

“......咱俩可没血缘关系。”

“呵......”

谢雨迟站起身来。

Chapter 23 Joint Investigation-"I Found a World BUG"

The world is far more complex than you think.

The first time Lin Shu had this idea was when he had just verified that the ritual of "Yarrow Turtle Divination" was effective.

The second time was when I was looking up at the stars in a mass grave.

And the third time is now.

But the feeling this time was completely different from the previous two.

The first two times, I just sighed about the "world rules", but this time, I asked about the "social rules under the world rules".

If the officials really understand and master the rituals, it would prove that they are living in a carefully woven isolation system.

They control the knowledge of rituals and prevent this knowledge from flowing in the world.

Isn't this a kind of... dictatorship?

But it’s not right if you think about it carefully.

If they really have understood everything about rituals long ago, then they should have also formed a mature and complete set of methods for handling "ritual ritual events" early on.

They shouldn't have been so obvious - at least they shouldn't have characterized Xu Changshun's case as murder, arousing the suspicion of all those who knew about it.

So overall...

At this moment, the official seems to be in a state of confusion where he has just come into contact with new things, just like himself?

The only difference is that they have a wider source of information and are likely to have information on many similar cases.

Perhaps, they even regarded these inexplicable "similar cases" as some new criminal methods and investigated them together...

Combined with Li Yu's guess about the "chaos"...

Yes, this is the most reasonable explanation.

Thinking of this, Lin Shu relaxed slightly.

----At least in this context, the official has not become the villain yet.

Otherwise, it would be safer to lie down directly...

"What are you thinking about?"

Xie Yuchi, who was sitting on the sofa, looked at Lin Shu curiously. Lin Shu came back to his senses, coughed and said:

"No, I was just thinking about Xu Changshun."

"Do you think it's possible that the police will ask for an autopsy to be opened?"

"It's certainly possible."

Xie Yuchi nodded.

"But that has nothing to do with you anymore - as I said before, you should stay less involved in things that should not be our business."

"Okay, I'm leaving."

"Are you free tomorrow night? Have a meal together?"

"A date?"

Lin Shu said something stupid, and Xie Yuchi rolled his eyes.

"I'm dating you. It sounds a bit orthopedic for you to say something like this."

"...We are not related by blood."

"Heh..."

Xie Yuchi stood up.
